'''Oobolo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] criminal who was [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Galactic Princess]]''. He ran a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall on board the ''Princess'' as a cover for his operation.
